description.p: mdwriter is a personal fork of ghostwriter, a distraction-free Markdown editor with a live HTML preview, theme creation, focus and full-screen modes, live word count, and document navigation. It ships the cmark-gfm Markdown processor and can integrate with Pandoc, MultiMarkdown, Discount and cmark processors if installed.
This fork adds VS Code theme import, VS Code-matching fonts, a preview-first layout, and is packaged as its own application so it can be installed alongside upstream ghostwriter.
